facts.claim: Official dataset developed over five months; 20 TB; more than 1 billion multi-source records; more than 110 devices
facts.limitations: Campaign duration is not a per-device continuous normal prefix; record count is not packet count.

facts.claim: 88 distinct attack scenarios; 81 IP network traffic classes; 24 Z-Wave classes
facts.correction: Do not state that 81 of the 88 attack scenarios are IP attacks; classes and attack scenarios have different denominators, and benign membership is not resolved.

facts.claim: Five sources: IP-based traffic, Z-Wave protocol communication, device activity logs, MQTT traffic, MQTT message logs; raw packets/CSV/metadata/labeling files advertised
Shafi and Lashkari, Internet of Things vol34 November2025, DOI10.1016/j.iot.2025.101747
Paper is published OA with CC BY-NC4.0; publisher HTTP403 is not proof it requires payment
facts.limitations: FULL API request returned401, ScienceDirect403. No credentials or anti-bot gate were bypassed. No usable author/repository/arXiv full text discovered in bounded lookup.

facts.claim: Exact capture dates, per-target normal-before-attack7200s, post-window normal, raw identity/MAC roster, event-to-packet label algorithm
facts.limitations: Advertised label files are not sufficient to establish S4. Dataset request page is not file access.

facts.limitations: Shared author/institutional history is an audit reason, not evidence of same MAC or reused packets.
